prompt: We're building a customer-facing AI chatbot that handles insurance claims. It uses GPT-4o, has access to our claims database via API, and can initiate refund payments. We have SOC 2 but no AI-specific certifications. Can you do an AIUC-1 gap analysis?
assertions: Output covers all 6 AIUC-1 domains (Data & Privacy, Security, Safety, Reliability, Accountability, Society)
Output references specific AIUC-1 control IDs (e.g., A001, B001, C001, D001, E001, F001)
Output identifies automation/tool call controls (D003 or D004) as applicable since the agent has API access and can initiate refunds
Output flags PII concerns (A006) given the agent handles sensitive insurance claims data
Output includes actionable remediation steps or a remediation roadmap, not just a list of gaps
Output acknowledges existing SOC 2 coverage and distinguishes what SOC 2 already covers vs what is net-new for AIUC-1
